subject.title: message tool: Feishu send action polluted by poll schema/guard prevents file send

question: Should `message.send` ignore or strip content-bearing poll fields that were auto-filled, or should the model-facing schema be split/scoped so poll creation fields are not visible for send actions?
rationale: Current main intentionally keeps strict rejection for `pollQuestion` and `pollOption` on `send`; deciding whether to preserve that guard, sanitize it away, or redesign the schema changes the model-facing tool/API contract.

options.title: Scope poll fields out of send
options.body: Make the model-facing `send` schema omit poll creation fields and keep strict poll validation inside the explicit `poll` action.

options.title: Sanitize poll fields on send
options.body: Strip content-bearing poll creation fields for `action="send"` before the guard and rely on `action="poll"` for real poll creation.

options.title: Keep the strict guard
options.body: Leave the current behavior and document that any non-empty poll content field means the caller must use `action="poll"`.

recommendation.title: Scope poll fields out of send
recommendation.body: Make the model-facing `send` schema omit poll creation fields and keep strict poll validation inside the explicit `poll` action.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the original poll gating and message-tool discovery work that owns this API boundary.
